declarations.name: AuiFieldset
declarations.description:
AbsoluteUI Fieldset: `<fieldset auiFieldset legend="Address">...controls...</fieldset>`.
Enhances the native fieldset in place with the legend, help text, required marker, and a
group error; the projected controls stay Angular-managed. Disabled is the native attribute.

inputs.name: legend
inputs.description: Visible legend; the group's accessible name.

inputs.name: hideLegend
inputs.description: Visually hide the legend (it stays the accessible name).

inputs.name: description
inputs.description: Help text for the group, referenced by aria-describedby.

inputs.name: required
inputs.description: Required marker; '(required)' is added to the spoken legend.

inputs.name: error
inputs.description: Group-level error message; empty or null hides it.

accessibility.pattern: Native fieldset and legend (HTML grouping): the legend names the group; help and the group error are referenced by aria-describedby.

limitations: The group error is set by the application (for example from Form validation); Fieldset does not validate its controls.
Native disabled disables native controls inside; AbsoluteUI controls inside keep their own disabled option in sync only through their native elements.
